coaching.title: Race Sim — Day 2 (Back-to-Back)
coaching.message: 14 mi with ~2,000 ft, mimicking the back half of the race, on legs already loaded from yesterday. Keep it Zone 2, patient — walk the first stretch to loosen up before settling into rhythm. This is peak-block work, so let the climbs feel like Julian Alps vert: steady power hiking on the ups, controlled and light on the downs. Combined with yesterday, that's 32 miles of race simulation across two days. First light start, full hydration from the gun.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: Same fueling and sodium plan as yesterday — consistency is the point of a B2B. Target 60-80g carbs/hr on course, sodium on schedule regardless of thirst. Pre-run: something easy and carb-forward you've used before, no experiments on tired legs. Post-run: hit protein + carbs within 30-60 minutes to kickstart repair before tomorrow's lighter day.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: This is the demanding half of a back-to-back — prioritize sodium and fluid replacement immediately, then legs up for 10-15 minutes this afternoon. Skip anything intense; save mobility work for tomorrow's active recovery day. Sleep is the biggest lever after a 32-mile two-day block, so protect it tonight.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: You're literally rehearsing the back half of Julian Alps right now, on pre-fatigued legs, at altitude-adjacent effort. When it gets heavy in the last few miles, that's the practice — stay patient, execute the plan you wrote, not the plan your legs want to write for you. This is exactly what race day will ask of you.
